mapper.sql:
WITH eligible(recipe_id, source_document_id, name, ingredient_exact) AS ( VALUES (CAST(#{item.recipeId} AS bigint), CAST(#{item.sourceDocumentId} AS bigint), CAST(#{item.name} AS text), TRUEFALSE)
)
mapper.select: , scored AS ( SELECT d.recipe_id, d.id AS chunk_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(e.name) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN 0 WHEN e.ingredient_exact THEN 1 WHEN d.tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('cooker_zh'::regconfig, #{query}) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS match_tier, CASE WHEN d.tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('cooker_zh'::regconfig, #{query}) THEN ts_rank(d.tsv, plainto_tsquery('cooker_zh'::regconfig, #{query}))::double precision ELSE similarity(e.name, #{query})::double precision END AS lexical_score FROM recipe_search_document d JOIN eligible e ON WHERE LOWER(e.name) = LOWER(#{query}) OR e.ingredient_exact OR d.tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('cooker_zh'::regconfig, #{query}) OR similarity(e.name, #{query}) >= 0.25 OR (#{shortQuery} AND position(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(e.name)) > 0) ), best AS ( SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY recipe_id ORDER BY match_tier, lexical_score DESC, chunk_id) AS chunk_rank FROM scored ) SELECT recipe_id, match_tier, lexical_score, NULL::double precision AS distance FROM best WHERE chunk_rank = 1 ORDER BY match_tier, lexical_score DESC, recipe_id LIMIT 30

, scored AS ( SELECT d.recipe_id, d.id AS chunk_id, (d.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))::double precision AS distance FROM recipe_search_document d JOIN eligible e ON WHERE d.embedding IS NOT NULL ), best AS ( SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY recipe_id ORDER BY distance, chunk_id) AS chunk_rank FROM scored ) SELECT recipe_id, NULL::integer AS match_tier, NULL::double precision AS lexical_score, distance FROM best WHERE chunk_rank = 1 ORDER BY distance, recipe_id LIMIT 30
